surface_name: Supabase Data API with row level security
title: Supabase select returns an empty array with no error even though the table has rows
symptoms: { data: [], error: null } for a table that has data in the Table Editor
Same query returns rows with the service role key or in the SQL editor
Works after disabling RLS on the table
cause: With RLS enabled and no policy that matches the caller's role, Postgres filters every row out instead of raising an error. A missing user session makes the request run as anon, which policies for authenticated never match.
fix: Add a SELECT policy for the role that actually makes the call, and confirm a user JWT is attached at call time by checking auth.jwt() through an RPC.
affected: All Supabase projects with RLS enabled on the queried table, which the dashboard enables by default for new tables
